review.rationale: CON.09 binds one canonical TransferTicket Foundation message, the authorized Sync/Resource/Transfer proto surface, exact owned constraint/operation scopes, generated bindings, and declarative fixtures. The active EXT.02 successor closure and all 800 predecessor generated targets are retained; only the exact CON.09 target additions and current generated-byte hashes are bound. Required scalar presence is represented by proto3 optional markers without changing tags or adding value constraints. The five owner-runtime vectors are declarative-only and are checked exactly once by the two existing Foundation consumers; CON.09 does not implement owner runtime behavior. Package identities, dependency versions/closure, generator pins and licence obligations remain unchanged.
